$doc: Mechanical checks of the round-5 routed shot notes (written by the round-5 showrunner). generator/film/shot-ledger.mjs finalize/check looks each string up in the shot source with comments stripped (plus sets/<id>-*.ts and any listed files, relative to the film's app dir): every 'present' string must appear, every 'absent' string must not. A 'fixed' outcome that misses is downgraded to 'partial'. Quoted words like 'habit' are T.word anchors. Purely visual notes (ch14-s07, ch04-s07, ch13-s03) carry no strings.
